# offline.page

> A free Markdown writing app with autocorrect and autocomplete that run entirely in the browser and keep working offline. Nothing typed is sent to a server.

## Links

- [The app](https://offlinepage.app/): open it and start writing; no account
- [Source code](https://github.com/cfahlgren1/offline-page): TypeScript, Tiptap and ONNX Runtime Web
- [tinyfix](https://huggingface.co/paperweight/tinyfix): the 2 MB autocorrect model
- [Models on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/paperweight): both on-device models
